newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Process Auto issues HK$15 mln loan notes.
newsitem.headline: Process Auto issues HK$15 mln loan notes.

text.p: Process Automation (Holdings) Ltd said on Tuesday it will issue HK$15 million in unsecured convertible loan notes convertible into company shares at a conversion price of HK$0.52 per share subject to adjustment.
The electroplating machines distributor said about 28.85 million shares, representing 8.4 percent of its enlarged share capital, will be issued upon full conversion of the notes.

The notes will bear interest at the rate of 6.5 percent per annnum payable semi-annually on March 31 and September 30 of each year, and the last day of interest payment will be on the second anniversary of the notes' issue date, it said.
The comapny said net proceeds would be used for general working capital and no application would be made for listing of the notes.
Completion of the placing and underwriting will be on January 2.
Shares of Process Automation were untraded at HK$0.51 per share in early trade on Tuesday.
